facts.text: Jolene mentioned that a shot reminded her of her last beach getaway, which she described as chill and nice.

evidence.quote: That shot was like a reminder of my last beach getaway. So chill and nice.
Glad it brought back good memories.

facts.text: Jolene expressed a hope that they might one day be able to watch the sunrise together.

facts.text: Deborah responded to Jolene's sunrise comment with a statement indicating she found the offer appealing.
